# Carpenterwala - Comprehensive Knowledge Base & Technical Services Overview

## 1. About Carpenterwala
Carpenterwala is India's verified home improvement marketplace connecting homeowners directly with background-checked carpenters, painters, plumbers, and electricians at 0% platform commission. Technician onboarding is open pan-India via Voice AI (`https://carpenterwala.com/join`) and Remote MCP (`https://carpenterwala.com/api/mcp`), while on-site verified homeowner bookings are currently active across Bangalore. All service providers undergo Aadhaar identity verification and background checks, with uploaded KYC documents stored in a strictly private admin-only bucket and auto-purged within 90 days.

- Website: https://carpenterwala.com
- Operations Hub: Thanisandra Main Road, Bangalore, Karnataka 560077, India (Doorstep service across Bangalore)
- Phone: +91-809-555-1001
- Email: contact@carpenterwala.com
- Operating Hours: Monday – Sunday, 08:00 AM – 09:00 PM IST

## 2. Interactive Calculation Engines
### Water Wastage & Tap Drip Cost Calculator
- Location: https://carpenterwala.com/services/plumbing#calculator
- Purpose: Quantifies municipal and tanker water wastage in Indian homes resulting from slow dripping taps, leaking flush valves, or pipe pinholes.
- Methodology: Converts drip frequency (e.g., 10 to 120 drops per minute) into daily and monthly litres lost and financial impact based on Bangalore municipal vs tanker water pricing.

### Electricity Appliance Consumption & Wastage Calculator
- Location: https://carpenterwala.com/services/electrical#calculator
- Purpose: Calculates power consumption (kWh / units) and monthly electricity bill increases caused by faulty wiring, inefficient appliances (fans, ACs, geysers, refrigerators), and vampire standby draw.
- Methodology: Maps appliance wattage and operational hours against standard BESCOM electricity tariff slabs.

### Wall Painting Area & Paint Quantity Estimator
- Location: https://carpenterwala.com/services/painting#calculator
- Purpose: Computes exact wall surface area, primer requirements, paint litres needed (1 coat vs 2 coats), and total material + labor budget for 1 BHK, 2 BHK, and 3 BHK residential apartments.

## 5. Model Context Protocol (MCP) & AI Agent Integration
Carpenterwala implements the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and OpenAPI 3.1 specification for autonomous AI agent discovery and tool execution across OpenAI ChatGPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, and Perplexity AI.

### Protocol Endpoints
- Remote MCP Server (JSON-RPC 2.0 / SSE, No Auth / Session-Based, CORS-enabled): `https://carpenterwala.com/api/mcp`
- MCP Server Card Manifest: `https://carpenterwala.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json`
- OpenAPI 3.1 Spec for Custom GPT & Agent Actions: `https://carpenterwala.com/api/mcp/openapi.json`
- REST Tool Route: `https://carpenterwala.com/api/mcp/tools/{toolName}`
- Zero-Setup Voice AI Onboarding Web App: `https://carpenterwala.com/join`

### JSON-RPC 2.0 Discovery Methods
- `initialize`: Returns protocol version (`2024-11-05`), server name (`carpenterwala-mcp-server`), and tool capabilities.
- `tools/list`: Lists all 6 active tools and their JSON Schemas.
- `tools/call`: Executes a tool with provided arguments and returns standard MCP text + structuredContent payloads.

### Tool Registry & Purpose (6 Active Tools)
1. `start_carpenterwala_onboarding`:
   - Starts Pan-India 0% commission onboarding for carpenters, painters, plumbers, and electricians (`phone_number`, `full_name`, `trade`, `city`, `locality`, optional `pincode`, `experience_years`, `email`).
   - Generates a short `session_token` and magic upload link (`https://carpenterwala.com/v/{token}`) valid for **60 minutes**.
   - **Dual-Handoff Response**: Returns both a mobile-first clickable magic link (`"Tap Here to Upload"`) for Android/mobile users (no login required, 7 Indian languages: English, हिन्दी, ಕನ್ನಡ, தமிழ், తెలుగు, मराठी, বাংলা, auto-compressed `<600KB` camera uploads) AND a desktop-friendly QR code of `verify_url`.
   - **Zero-Trust Security Flow**: Aadhaar, PAN, Voter ID/DL, and Police Verification photos are uploaded directly from the technician's phone into a strictly private admin-only Supabase Storage bucket (`kyc-documents`, JPEG/PNG/WebP only, max 2MB). Sensitive government IDs never enter 3rd-party LLM chat transcripts.
   - **Abuse Prevention**: Strict 10-digit Indian mobile validation (`^[6-9][0-9]{9}$`), 60-minute token expiry with localized `"Link Expired"` messaging, IP rate limiting (60 MCP requests/hr per IP), and persistent 24-hour DB-backed rate limiting (max 5 sessions per 24 hours per mobile number).
2. `check_onboarding_status`:
   - Polls the onboarding session state (`PENDING_UPLOAD`, `VERIFIED`, or `EXPIRED`) by `session_token` or 10-digit Indian `phone_number`.
   - Returns a welcome message and live public profile URL once the technician completes document upload and reaches `VERIFIED`.
3. `search_verified_pros`:
   - Queries background-checked verified pros filtered by trade and locality.
4. `get_service_rate_card`:
   - Returns official standard labor rates in INR (₹) at 0% platform commission.
5. `calculate_service_estimate`:
   - Computes wall painting square footage & paint liters, tap drip water wastage (litres/₹), or appliance power consumption.
6. `request_service_callback`:
   - Logs customer service inquiries and dispatches direct leads to local handymen with 60-90 min response time.
